top_signals.title: Want to Rent an Internet Address at the White House?
top_signals.summary: Several staffers at the White House are using computers or mobile devices equipped with residential proxy services that render their internet address available for others to rent, security experts warned today. One of the proxy services is a Russian company whose founder's web hosting business was ground zero for cyberattacks against election systems in Arizona and Illinois in 2016.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: US-Backed Lithium Americas Hit by Rising Costs on Trump Tariffs
top_signals.summary: Lithium Americas Corp.’s Nevada mine was supposed to be the US solution to curbing dependence on China for a critical mineral for batteries. Instead, the company is getting hammered by the Trump administration’s tariffs.
